# @arki/failure

> Typed failures for TypeScript with no wrapper. A function returns `Value | Failure<...>`, the compiler infers the union, and every caller must check. Owned boundaries return typed defects with private causes.

## Import paths
<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/failure`: typed failures returned as plain values, with no wrapper. `AsyncSchema`, `FAILURE_ERROR_CODES`, `FailureError`, `InvalidEnvelope`, `InvalidInput`, `REVIVAL_FAILURES`, `SCHEMA_FAILURES`, `UnexpectedDefect`, `UnexpectedFailure`, `ValidatorDefect`, `assertNever`, `attempt`; and 31 more.
- `@arki/failure/eslint`: the `must-use` and `no-blind-accept` rules. `default`, `mustUse`, `noBlindAccept`.
- `@arki/failure/orpc`: failures at an oRPC boundary. `RPC_FAILURE_DEFINITION`, `errorMap`, `orThrowRpc`, `reviveRpcError`, `rpcFailureDefinitions`; types `DeclaredErrors`, `ErrorMapOf`.
- `@arki/failure/schema`: Minimal Standard Schema execution shared by schema parsing and failure revival. `SCHEMA_FAILURES`, `isAsyncSchemaFailure`, `isSchemaFailure`, `parse`, `parseAsync`; types `AsyncSchemaFailure`, `SchemaFailure`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- A discarded call drops its failure. Turn on `failure/must-use`.
- Check with `isFailure` or `Def.is`. Truthiness does not narrow.
- Misuse throws `FailureError`. Do not catch it; fix the call.
- Wire schemas must synchronously accept their lossless JSON output unchanged.
- A returned failure does not roll back a transaction.
